Summarizes the registered coordinates used for cross-modality analyses.

**Inputs:** Coordinate manifests and registered coordinates in `paper_data/Registration`.

**Outputs:** A coordinate inventory in `results/` for the Xenium–MILAN and Xenium–Visium analyses.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Set these root folders before running the notebook.
data_root <- 'path_to_input'
output_root <- 'path_to_output'

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

```

```{r load_libraries}

library(dplyr)
data_dir <- file.path(data_root, 'Registration')
outdir <- file.path(output_root, 'Registration', 'results')
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

## Registered coordinates

```{r coordinates}

samples <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, 'samples.csv'))
summary <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(samples)), function(i) {
  row <- samples[i, ]
  coordinates <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, row$file))
  data.frame(workflow = row$workflow, sample_id = row$sample_id,
             modality = row$modality, points = nrow(coordinates))
})
write.csv(bind_rows(summary), file.path(outdir, 'registered_coordinates.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

```
